checks.name: Every row has an official source; every published value is in its quoted text; every unconfirmed value is blank
checks.proves: No row carries a value without a source and a quote, every number in a value appears in the text recorded from the page, and blank rows really are blank and say why.
checks.does_not_prove: That the quote was transcribed correctly from the page. Each quote can be checked against its link by hand.
checks.result: 441 rows checked one by one: 360 verified, 37 computed, 37 unverified and blank, 7 withheld and blank

checks.name: Every computed value is recalculated from verified rows
checks.proves: Each derived figure equals its stated formula applied to numbers that appear in the quoted text of verified rows.
checks.does_not_prove: That the formula is the right one for the purpose; the formula is shown beside each value.
checks.result: 37 computed values recalculated from their inputs; no differences

checks.name: Every source is an official publisher, and nothing is published from a page that could not be read
checks.proves: Every source address is a secure government address (filings are read on the securities regulator's site), and a source that failed to load supports only blank rows.
checks.does_not_prove: That the page is still online or unchanged today.
checks.result: 50 sources on 34 government hosts, all read on 2026-11-13 except 1 that could not be read and carries no value

checks.name: Every row of every evidence table on the published pages carries a link to an official site
checks.proves: The rule is met on the pages as published, not only in the data files.
checks.does_not_prove: Tables that describe the site itself (suggestions, requirements, archive, deployment) link to the part of the site or repository they describe instead.
checks.result: 914 rows in 76 evidence and model tables on 22 pages; every row links to an official source

checks.name: Numbers written in sentences come from the evidence cited beside them
checks.proves: A figure in a risk, question, irregularity or summary sentence appears in the rows it cites, in the model output, or is a year or a small count.
checks.does_not_prove: That the sentence draws the right conclusion from the figure.
checks.result: 103 risk, question, irregularity and summary texts checked; every number in them is in the evidence they cite

checks.name: The model's anchors equal the verified rows, and its output is reproducible
checks.proves: Settings marked as anchors are identical to the published ledger values, and re-running the model gives the published results to the last digit.
checks.does_not_prove: That the assumptions are right. They are labelled, ranged and tested on the Projections page.
checks.result: 36 settings: 8 anchors equal their ledger rows, 28 labelled assumptions; output reproduced exactly (20,000 trials per expiry year, seed 20261112)

checks.name: No broken internal links anywhere in the published tree
checks.proves: Every link from one page of this repository to another, on the consolidated site and in every archived workbook, points at a file that exists.
checks.does_not_prove: That external pages are still online; the build environment cannot reach them.
checks.result: 7,013 internal links on 286 pages across the whole repository resolve, including the archive

checks.name: Nothing personal is published
checks.proves: The complete published repository, including archived workbooks, is scanned for names and personal identifiers; every property and owner row is blank.
checks.does_not_prove: Whether a pattern scan can identify every possible form of personal information; human review is still appropriate.
checks.result: 584 text files across the entire published repository scanned: no e-mail address, telephone number, street address, parcel number or named individual; every property and owner row is blank

checks.name: Pages load nothing from other sites
checks.proves: Opening a page contacts no third party; the only outside addresses are links the reader chooses to follow.
checks.does_not_prove: Anything about the hosting service itself.
checks.result: 64 scripts and style sheets referenced, all served from this repository; no outside script, font, image or tracker

checks.name: Every page is in the menu and every archived workbook is listed
checks.proves: No page of the consolidated site is orphaned, and no earlier workbook has been dropped from view.
checks.does_not_prove: That the archived workbooks are correct; they are preserved, not endorsed.
checks.result: 21 menu entries, each with a page; 23 archived workbooks, each listed on the archive page

checks.name: The decision-critical figures were re-read on 2026-11-13 and the numbers found again match the ledger
checks.proves: Each re-read number of a ledger value appears in the text copied from its official page on the re-read date, and every number of a value is either re-read or listed as not re-read.
checks.does_not_prove: That the copied text is exact, or that the page has not changed since the copy. Each re-read can be checked by hand at its link.
checks.result: 9 official pages re-opened on 2026-11-13; 12 ledger rows; 13 numbers found again in the text recorded from the page; 2 numbers listed as not re-read; no ledger value changed

checks.name: The published pages are exactly what the generator produces
checks.proves: Nobody has edited a generated page by hand; the pages match the data.
checks.result: 25 generated files rebuilt and compared byte for byte; identical
